releaseNotes: Public preview SDK for NexatomTT on Windows x64.
Updates the SDK manual, adds inline workflow explanations to the C/C++ and Python acquisition templates, and simplifies the public package manifest.

Native acquisition behaviour is unchanged from preview.7. Its ZYNQ_004 internal-pulse qualification covered service return, all six C/C++/Python processed/raw workflows, saved-file decoding, digital delay through 256 ns and close/reopen.
Single active instrument. Kintex and legacy Zynq hardware qualification for this preview and external analog validation remain pending. Firmware is supplied separately.
